upstream source:
https://www.bendstudio.com/assets/cms/downloads/code_final_candidate.zip
https://www.bendstudio.com/blog/inside-bend-screen-space-shadows/

UVSR retains the released bend_sss_cpu.h and bend_sss_gpu.h without modification.
UVSR supplies the renderer adapter, shader permutation configuration, and
angular-light sampling and accumulation. the optional Wave Optimizations path
uses the retained Bend planner and tracer. disabling that path does not remove
the included code or compiled shaders from this distribution.
